category.name: Login and single sign-on
category.description: Workforce SSO, application/customer identity and web access authentication; distinct use cases with partial overlap.
category.audience: IT/security teams managing employee application access and software teams implementing customer login.
category.audienceRationale: Employee access spans industries; customer IAM also serves businesses operating applications. Deployment requires identity and security expertise.

pricing.note: Starter suite advertised per user/month, billed annually; standalone products/add-ons differ.
Displayed Essentials B2C price for 500 monthly active users; B2B and MAU selections change price; free plan also exists.

oss.name: Keycloak
oss.classificationReason: Community IAM product; documented SSO, federation, administration, MFA and authorization included. No project commercial feature edition identified. Third-party hosting/support not counted as a project hosted offering.

oss.name: ZITADEL
oss.classificationReason: Current core uses AGPL v3, replacing Apache licensing for v3 onward; commercial license/support and managed cloud available. Vendor describes same core across deployments; cloud usage limits are not self-hosted feature locks. Package exceptions may apply.

health.rsx: Central rsx analyze evidence: overall 5.3/10; automated license verdict reviewed against pinned LICENSE.

oss.name: Authelia
oss.classificationReason: Community product includes documented reverse-proxy authentication, MFA and OIDC. No commercial feature edition or project-hosted service identified; scope is narrower than full workforce lifecycle or customer identity suites.

health.rsx: Central rsx analyze evidence: overall 7.7/10; automated license verdict reviewed against pinned LICENSE.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Reconfigure applications for OIDC/SAML, migrate or federate directories, rebuild policies and login flows. Covers identity provider/login needs; assess workforce lifecycle and vendor integration parity separately.
Supports SAML/OIDC and directory/proxy protocols. Recreate app integrations, policy flows and user stores. Some workplace provisioning/security integrations require Enterprise.

Reconfigure applications for OIDC/SAML, migrate or federate directories, rebuild policies and login flows. Covers identity provider/login needs; assess workforce lifecycle and vendor integration parity separately.
Supports SAML/OIDC and directory/proxy protocols. Recreate app integrations, policy flows and user stores. Some workplace provisioning/security integrations require Enterprise.
Customer and B2B identity infrastructure with managed or self-hosted deployment. Adapt application issuer/client settings and migrate users, organizations and policies; not an SDK-compatible swap.

Useful for internal web apps secured by reverse proxy or OIDC. Requires proxy/app configuration and an identity backend; does not replace the whole workforce lifecycle, governance and SaaS provisioning suite.

uncertainties: No migration was executed; all mappings are capability comparisons, not parity guarantees.
